يبتذلون (form VIII)
# يَبْتَذِلُونَ (yabtaḏilūna) /jab.ta.ði.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
# يُبْتَذَلُونَ (yubtaḏalūna) /jub.ta.ða.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
